title: Love Others
verse: The second is: ‘.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.
observation: Soooooo hard. I love that God gave us more commandments on how to love our neighbor than on how to love Him. It's easier to love God than to love our neighbor. I'm thankful He gets that and helps us.
application: Where do I need to grow in my love for others?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a pattern to love our neighbor by how You love us.
